placements.why: The content is about reproducing a production failure to verify pipeline behavior — an organizational category for proof and testing that nothing in the existing strata or structure covers.
placements.title: Verification Through Reproduction
placements.frame: What must the system guarantee when confronted with patterns that already broke it?

placements.title: From Production Failure to Acceptance Criterion
placements.frame: What must the pipeline guarantee when it encounters a pattern that already broke production?
placements.why: src-1 names the concrete production failure being reproduced — a ## heading arriving without an id field — and src-2 sets the two non-negotiable acceptance criteria: no crash, valid slug output. Together they form a problem-to-requirement arc where the defect and its fix are two faces of the same competence demand. The conviction gradient (src-1 a settled claim about what exists, src-2 an operational decision about what must hold) is the tension this leaf holds for future envelopes to feed.
